basic_info.description: Step into this lovely sunlit home that blends mid-century charm with a prime northeast Bernal Heights location. This rare gem offers a beautifully updated living space with significant improvements done in 2024, including a remodeled kitchen with custom cabinetry and new appliances, a refreshed bathroom, a new roof, new deck, new garage door and opener, and upgraded 100 amp electrical service. Gleaming refinished oak floors and fresh interior paint add warmth and brightness throughout. Enjoy sweeping views from the living room, rear bedroom, and deck - stretching from Potrero Hill to Candlestick Point, across the Bayshore to the Bay, and all the way to the Oakland Hills and Mount Diablo. Outside, a spacious patio leads to a charming backyard with a pear tree, magnolia tree and other established plantings. The well-lit tandem garage accommodates two cars and includes additional space ideal for an office, gym, hobby room, or storage - with potential to add a room and bathroom. Located near Bernal Heights Park, MUNI 67, BART, and easy access to both 101 and 280, this home offers charm, updates, views, unbeatable convenience and great neighborhood!
